elements.element: Commercial general liability USD 1M per occurrence
elements.evidence: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence
(b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000

elements.element: Cyber/privacy USD 5M where Customer Data processed
elements.evidence: (c) where Commerce One processes Corio data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

elements.element: Workers' compensation as required by law
elements.evidence: (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law
shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance upon request

elements.element: Vendor is the insuring party (obligation runs to Customer)
elements.evidence: Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement
errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000
cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

reasons: All seven atomic preferred elements are expressly present: CGL 1M/occurrence and 2M aggregate, E&O 2M, cyber/privacy 5M conditioned on processing Corio data, workers' compensation as required by applicable law, and certificates on request, all as Vendor (Commerce One) obligations.

The insertion is a concise, self-contained covenant for an otherwise absent clause; no post-termination coverage tail, no indemnity, no additional-insured or waiver-of-subrogation boilerplate was added, so nothing more was changed than needed.
Surrounding sections 14.9 and 14.10 are untouched and remain fully effective; no defined term is altered and no dangling mechanic is created.
Two cosmetic notes only, not deviations: the new section is numbered 14.11 but rendered ahead of existing 14.10, and 'Corio data' is used descriptively rather than as a defined term.
